Class AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandlerTest

@IsTest()
private class AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandlerTest

Unit tests for AsyncJobEventSubscriberHandler and AsyncJobEventSubscriber trigger. Validates platform event processing for Queueable, Batch, and Flow job types, including AsyncOptions support, AsyncJob__c status tracking, and error handling for missing JobKey__c and invalid class names.
